Discussion

Questions, ideas and reports about re:psn go in one thread. It is a GitHub Discussions thread in the repository of the undecuple/me site, shown here with giscus. To write you sign in with GitHub, and what you write is public on GitHub. Bugs and feature requests are better as issues.

Nothing is requested from giscus.app or GitHub until you press the button. Pressing it loads a script and a frame from giscus.app, which talks to GitHub; their own terms and privacy policies apply to that. This is the only page of this site that loads anything from another site. Without the button you can read and write in the Discussions on GitHub.
